text: Hey, we really need to meet about the history presentation before it is due next week. You are right. Are you free on Wednesday afternoon after the lecture? Wednesday is tricky because I work until five. Could we meet in the evening instead? Sure, six o'clock at the library works for me if that suits you. Great. Should we split the topic so we each prepare half before we meet? Good idea. I can cover the first half, and you take the second. Could we each bring two reliable sources to support our part? Yes, I will find two sources for my section before we meet. Perfect. After comparing our notes, we can rehearse the whole presentation. That sounds useful. We can also check how long it takes.
